name: WGS GS2 queue lifetime search
purpose: CPU admission filtering only; no generated CUDA variants, GPU use, timing prediction, or Lean proof

fixed.af_bank_selector: ci % af_banks, reset at each stage
fixed.release: after the selected group's commit and wait
preserve: all MMA operands and K order
all producer and consumer barrier participants
original packing, routing, epilogues and finalizer

coverage.scope: Finite conservative event checks covering empty, full, partial and adjacent segments, all modeled ring slots/generations and NTT values. Not every possible route, length sequence or CUDA scheduling interleaving.

require: actual compiled attributes for exact source and specialization
actual occupancy query at the fixed block and dynamic shared-memory size
device_gate.note: 96 is a register-only admission limit established with NVIDIA's unmodified occupancy header and SM90 properties; it is not a complete device query or a predictor from logical AF word counts.
